summary: ZIM Integrated Shipping Services Ltd. announced via Form 6-K the abrupt departure of CFO Xavier Destriau, who notified the CEO and board of his decision to leave. Destriau will serve a six-month notice period for orderly transition. The board appointed Sami Jubran, current VP of Financial Planning and Analysis, as successor effective upon Destriau's departure. Jubran has been with ZIM since 2007 in senior financial roles. No stake, price, premium, or advisor details are relevant. This is a sudden CFO change, not a routine circular. Watch for any strategic shifts or shareholder reaction during the transition.
